g.text: MinVelRusalka begins.
Check boolean VelimirEclipse
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:CheckDuviriMitwCollectibles
true
Chat ends.
false
Hey... guys?
true
Chat ends.
false
MomToxicated: Yes?
PapaPolar: what's up lil buddy?
I have good news and I have bad news. About Neci.
I need you both not to get your hopes up. I have news about Neci, but it's... mixed. And inconclusive.
Fff... Actually, never mind. [End.]
PapaPolar: do it the adult way. bad news first.
+5 Chemistry
Chat ends.
MomToxicated: I agree. Bad news always comes first.
MomToxicated: All things in life generally are. But thank you for the warning.
So. The Indifference went to Duviri. and it... took Neci there with it.
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: wait. wait wait. that storybook dimension thing?
PapaPolar: bracing for the news, but it sounds like she's... not dead, at least?
MomToxicated: The one with the child dictator that kept killing you repeatedly?
I don't... know. I don't think so. But let me just tell you what I do know, and I'll let you two be the judges.
Turns out this was kind of a growth moment for him? Not the point. Anyway-
That's the one.
Neci... took the throne. The Murmur - The Indifference's "army" for lack of a better word, invaded, and she took over.
MomToxicated: Heh. That's my little girl.
PapaPolar: but was it really *her* though? or just that thing wearing her face?
I don't know.
That's what I wanted to talk to you about.
I found these records. They were disjointed at first. But when I put them all together, I... got this message.
I was curious if it made any sense to you.
MomToxicated: Riddles and strange messages? You're speaking our language.
PapaPolar: 1-800-spy-shit, you've come to the right place
"For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home."
PapaPolar: ....shit. M. SHIT.
MomToxicated: Don't fall for it. If that thing's inside her head, it knows what she knows.
What? What does it mean?
It's the other half, isn't it?
PapaPolar: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse."
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: what i told you to tell our lil girl if you saw her again.
PapaPolar: you got it...
PapaPolar: it was our half of a code phrase. how we started each phone call so we knew we were on a secure line and everything was safe
PapaPolar: we had a code phrase. it was how we started each phone call so we knew we were on a secure line and everything was safe
MomToxicated: That we were actually... ourselves.
PapaPolar: "On empty crossroads, seek the eclipse" was our half.
MomToxicated: "For when Sol and Lua align, the lost shall find their way home" was the responding half.
MomToxicated: *Her* half.
But we can't be sure it was her, like you said, Minerva. The Indifference knows what she knows.
I don't know why the Indifference would tell you that...
MomToxicated: But why would it be trying to give us a sense of hope? Unless it was simply trying to hurt us.
MomToxicated: Through false hope, perhaps? To cause us pain?
PapaPolar: is this painful?
PapaPolar: is it false, though? is this painful?
PapaPolar: or is it some kind of peace, to know our little girl is still alive out there, somewhere?
PapaPolar: that despite all odds, she's still kicking ass and taking names?
PapaPolar: even if it isn't with us?
PapaPolar: that warms my big dumb heart, i don't know about you.
PapaPolar: 'n something tells me that's not what the so-called indifference is in the business of doing
MomToxicated: You're very right. Hearing that phrase, thinking she even *might* still be out there, isn't painful.
MomToxicated: I'm proud of her.
Even if she's still being held hostage by the Indifference?
Even if it's a trick by the Indifference?
She could be willingly working with the Indifference.
PapaPolar: she's as tough as a bag of framing nails in a big 'ol block of cast titanium
MomToxicated: Why? What for? What does he have to gain from the two of us?
MomToxicated: Then she has one of the most powerful allies in the universe. In existence. She picked a side. So did we.
PapaPolar: and i'm betting yer "man in the wall" knew that, and that's why he took her in the first place
PapaPolar: we're small fry to that thing. which i say in the best way possible
MomToxicated: Hopefully, we'll never have to point guns at each other. And if we do? Then we'll deal with it.
PapaPolar: nah. she'll be fine. either she's already long gone, or they've got a mutual arrangement, or she's holding his ass hostage. lol
MomToxicated: No, I think the message was real. And I think it was from our little girl. Telling us... she's still out there.
PapaPolar: she's can take care of herself, though. that's how we raised her
MomToxicated: Telling us, in her own way, that she's "okay."
MomToxicated: And that we can stop worrying about her.
PapaPolar: heh. like we ever could
MomToxicated: The curse and blessing of being a parent.
PapaPolar: you ever want kids, drifter? eeeh, don't answer that. probably some void nonsense i don't wanna know about.
Drinks? Drinks.
Good call.
<RETRO_EMOJI_OHNO>
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: well, it's not a happy-happy smile. it's a melancholy-happy smile? but
MomToxicated: That is a valid response, I agree. Heh. What do you both say to a few drinks?
MomToxicated: Now you're really speaking our language.
PapaPolar: i'd like to go put back a few and tell some good stories about our lil girl
PapaPolar: now yer talkin'
MomToxicated: And... Drifter? Thank you. Again. For all that you do.
PapaPolar: yeah. seriously, lil buddy. i don't know how we'll ever be able to repay you. but if the chance comes? we'll be there.
PapaPolar: you're family now, whether you like it or not. 8-)
Chat ends.
